candidates.statement: Inventory service shows 21 configuration_rejections and error_rate 0.15 while gateway, order, and payment remain at error_rate 0.001 with no timeouts or pool waiters, indicating a bad configuration in inventory driving the checkout error-rate alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Latency p95 is 73ms across all services, so the latency portion of the alert is not explained; configuration rejection details and logs are unavailable.

report.explanation: Only inventory deviates: 21 configuration_rejections and error_rate 0.15 versus 0.001 elsewhere, with no dependency timeouts or db pool waiters. This supports a bounded bad-configuration candidate in inventory; latency is unexplained and configuration details are missing.
missing_evidence: Inventory configuration rejection logs or error messages to confirm bad-configuration cause
Inventory error-rate baseline to confirm 0.15 is anomalous
Evidence explaining the latency portion of the alert
